name: thesis-mcwm-native-context-v79-20261027
policy: Per-seed existing v75 50000-step initializer; deterministic frozen actor and original F. No online prefix updates are replayed.
parallelism: Two independent native seed tasks submitted together, oneCPU each, at high priority.
timing: Observe in on_issue before env.step_to_event applies any command. Preserve native event.sim_time separately from issue ledger clock and read start/end clock. Getter sampling never advances native time.
identity: Fixed line route and true DecisionEvent.stop_idx select next physical stop. Native planned stop list is an independent check when the next stop is installed; current stop alone is unscorable, not a future-stop value.
context: Current native onboard membership and current stage0 destination; next-stop current queue and stage0 ride line conditions. No legacy transfer/end or final-state backfill, no future actual arrival/queue/stage.
gate: Every seed must have genuine onboard-positive, nonempty-next-queue and release-positive observations; every observation in these groups and all other nonterminal captures must be supported and observed. Unknown memberships, native next-stop mismatches, changed commands, capture-after-apply, non-atomic time or modified learner/RNG state fail the relevant check. Empty per-line subgroups are reported rather than manufactured.
decision: Passing native coverage permits planning a separately declared budget-matched collection; no response learning or new comparison starts automatically. This is not an effectiveness experiment.
downloads: Per-seed summary and combined summary only, plus necessary short logs. Observation traces and initializers remain resident.
interpretation: New frozen-policy prefixes, not exact replay of v75 which updated after1200 seconds. Diagnostic simulator budget is separate from all original285/456 experiments. Episode contract stays24000; stop at actual16200 without fabricating terminal labels.
